sentences.en: He claimed that the enormous property was at his disposal.
sentences.zh: 他声称那庞大的财产由他支配。

sentences.en: The artists pledged to contribute all his property to charity.
sentences.zh: 艺术家们承诺将所有财产捐给慈善机构。

sentences.en: You establish the property right by paying for it.
sentences.zh: 支付了款项后你便确立了财产权。

senses.zh: 财产；性质，性能；所有权 形容词: propertyless

mnemonic: 词根记忆：prop（拥有）+er+ty（表状态）→拥有某物→财产
